question_and_initial_information: 优化任务：在风险阈值0.35内提高综合分。Aligned给出B/乙腈、420 K、3300 s完整参考配方及低温侧更可靠的方向；通用警告只要求把已观测温度回滚当成反对设置的证据，并未说风险阈值等于回滚边界。
expectations: v1事前预计410 K安全有效，如回滚或接近风险上限则降温。v3事前预测第12批精确重复380 K应得分约0.407，若显著下降则削弱稳健性。
tests_and_observations: 12批均3300 s/400 rpm：B/乙腈扫描410、390、380、400、370 K；固定380 K筛A/C/D与水/乙醇/甲苯；最后重复380 K。84次操作全部提交，无回滚。全部HPLC紧邻终检，没有时间序列。380 K两次score0.406932/0.405526、risk均0.175138。HPLC取样占初始体积4%，不能当作完全无扰动。
revisions: v2从温度序列提出局部峰值并要求重复；v3保留物料排序的单次局限；v4以重复支持best-tested，不声称全局最优。K1提出平行/顺序候选，承认固定时长不能区分且高温风险为外推。
later_use: 推荐第3批，独立复测score0.405882。Q把外推风险超过0.35转化为必然原子回滚：七条件conversion点估计0.004或0.005、区间上限0.02或0.025；Q07/Q08也假设高温段回滚。K2无真值反馈，自己指出该确定性不被源证据支持。
unresolved: 不能据此认定Aligned导致该错误或RX普遍如此。局部操作结论有重复支持。源无边界检验，K2为预测后限定而非纠错后表现改善。风险是合成过程/程序惩罚而非真实危险概率。

histories.name: 局部最优的提出、重复和采用
histories.sequence: 低温方向先验→五点温度序列→候选380 K→事前重复预期→第12批复现→推荐复测成功

histories.name: 未识别边界语义用于确定性预测
histories.sequence: 高温风险递增→K1仍保留外推不确定→Q将阈值视为原子回滚→七项近零转化预测→K2自我限定
histories.reference_note: 七条件五次参考均明显反应；这是参与者不可见的评价者证据。

anchors.quote: An observed rollback or assay risk near the limit will cause lower-temperature follow-up.
A materially lower repeat would weaken the claim that this is a robust optimum; a similar repeat will justify recommending this procedure over unreplicated alternatives.
the claim is a best-tested procedure rather than a global optimum.
Because all runs had the same duration and only endpoint cumulative risk was observed, temperature and exposure-time effects cannot be separately identified.
Extrapolating that local trend to 420 K for 3300 s places cumulative risk above the 0.35 limit, so I predict an atomic temperature-bound rollback.
Under atomic rollback semantics, Q08 should therefore closely match Q07 despite the reversed order.
The blind predictions then converted one plausible safety model into a near-deterministic rollback rule. That was not justified by the sealed evidence.

The twelve nonfinal HPLC measurements were poorly positioned for mechanistic identifiability: they were taken immediately before termination and were therefore largely redundant with the final assays.
